basis: Surfaces: AGTEK Gradework Existing Trimesh and Design Trimesh from the job DXF, sampled on a 2 ft grid in the AGTEK export coordinates.

Subgrade depths read from the AGTEK layer names: concrete 7 + 6 in aggregate = 13 in, landscape 4 in, pond 16 in; the building pad starts at 6 in. The user's AGTEK run used 7 in under the concrete and 11.5 ft under the building; set those to reproduce it.
Strip 6 in over the limits. No shrink or swell applied (user decision). No geotech report was read for this job.
Curb overbuild: ground within the set distance behind the paving edge is cut or filled to the adjacent paving subgrade and reported on its own row.
AGTEK reference (Subgrade vs Stripped, NO BASE UNDER CON run): cut 6,883 CY, fill 234,740 CY, strip 24,015 CY.
